LanguageData.Beamwire_RotateDesc: Turn this node 45°. Turning it by hand switches it to Manual, so auto-aim leaves it alone.
LanguageData.Beamwire_AutoAimDesc: When on, the network aims this node for you so beams reach as many receivers as possible. It re-aims whenever nodes or walls change. Turn it off, or rotate the node by hand, to aim it yourself.
LanguageData.Beamwire_ThroughputDesc: Cycle the most power this emitter will put into its beam.
LanguageData.Beamwire_ShowBeamsDesc: Draw all power beams on the map. When off, beams only show while a beam node is selected.
LanguageData.Beamwire_InspectAimAutoOff: Aim: auto (auto-aim is off in the mod settings)
LanguageData.Beamwire_InspectAimShaken: Aim: knocked out of alignment, will re-aim soon
LanguageData.Beamwire_InspectNoRoute: No beam route: no emitter can reach this receiver. Add mirrors, splitters or relays, or clear the way.
LanguageData.Beamwire_ShutterModeDesc: Cycle the shutter mode. Auto closes while a colonist, colony animal, prisoner or guest is in the beam beyond the shutter, and reopens when they're clear; hostiles don't trigger it. Always open and always closed ignore everyone.
LanguageData.Beamwire_Misaligned: The blast knocked the {0} out of alignment. If it is on auto-aim, it will re-aim itself in about an hour.
LanguageData.Beamwire_Style_Standard: Rim Standard (vanilla look, warm power beams)
LanguageData.Beamwire_Style_Industrial: Hazard Industrial (hazard stripes, orange power beams)
LanguageData.Beamwire_Style_Spacer: Glitterworld Spacer (white ceramic, teal power beams)
LanguageData.Beamwire_Setting_AutoAim_Desc: Nodes set to Auto aim themselves so beams reach as many receivers as possible, re-aiming whenever the network changes. Rotating a node by hand switches it to Manual.
LanguageData.Beamwire_Setting_Damage_Desc: Anyone standing in a powered beam takes burn damage that grows with the power it carries.
LanguageData.Beamwire_Setting_ShowBeams_Desc: When off, beams only show while a beam node is selected.
LanguageData.Beamwire_Setting_Weather_Desc: Rain and fog cost a little power per tile outdoors. Smoke and other gases also dim beams.
LanguageData.Beamwire_Setting_RoofBlocks_Desc: When on, beams can only travel under open sky.
LanguageData.Beamwire_Setting_Dust_Desc: Nodes slowly lose efficiency to dust (faster outdoors) until a colonist cleans them.
LanguageData.Beamwire_Setting_NodeLoss: Loss per mirror, splitter or relay: {0}%
LanguageData.Beamwire_Setting_Range: Beam range from an emitter or relay: {0} tiles
